attempts.artifact:
Feature: Login Functionality
  As a system user
    Given the Doctor, Chemists, and Labs have been set up with default passwords by Admin
    And the login page is accessible

  Scenario: Successful login with correct credentials
    Given a user with valid credentials attempts to log in
    When the user enters the correct username and password
    Then the system should grant access and redirect to the user dashboard
    Examples:
    | username    | password    | expected outcome          |
    | admin       | adminpass   | access granted, redirect  |

  Scenario: Unsuccessful login due to incorrect credentials
    Given a user with invalid credentials attempts to log in
    When the user enters the incorrect username and password
    Then the system should deny access and show an error message
    Examples:
    | username    | password    | access denied, error    |
    | wronguser   | wrongpass   | denied, error         |

  Scenario: Login with empty credentials
    Given a user with empty credentials attempts to log in
    When the user leaves the username and password fields empty
    Then the system should display an error message for missing credentials
    Examples:
    | username    | password    | missing credentials error |
    | guest       |            | error for empty fields  |

  Scenario: Login with too many failed attempts
    Given a user has multiple failed login attempts
    When the user enters the correct credentials after several failures
    Then the system should lock the account and prompt for account recovery
    Examples:
    | username    | password    | account locked, recovery prompt |
    | user1       | userpass1    | locked, recovery prompt |

  Scenario: Boundary case for failed login attempts
    Given a user has just one failed login attempt
    When the user enters the correct credentials after the attempt
    Then the system should not lock the account but may show a warning
    Examples:
    | username    | password    | no lock, possible warning |
    | userA       | userpassA    | no lock, possible warning |

  Scenario: Unsuccessful login with special characters
    Given a user with special characters in the username or password attempts to log in
    When the user enters special characters in the username or password
    Then the system should sanitize the input and proceed with login
    Examples:
    | username    | password    | input sanitized, proceed |
    | user!@#    | userp@#1    | sanitized, proceed      |

  Scenario: Login with excessively long credentials
    Given a user enters an excessively long username and password
    When the user attempts to log in
    Then the system should handle the input without errors and proceed with login
    Examples:
    | username    | password    | excessive length, proceed |
    | superlongusername | superlongpassword | handled, proceed    |

Scenario Outline: Negative login path with invalid credentials
  Background: The system should handle various invalid login attempts
  Scenario: Login with invalid credentials
    Given a user with invalid credentials attempts to log in
    When the user enters incorrect username and password
    Then the system should deny access and show an error message
    Examples:
    | username    | password    | access denied, error    |
    | wronguser   | wrongpass   | denied, error         |
    Examples:
    | guest       |            | error for empty fields  |
    | admin       | wrongpass   | denied, error         |

  Examples:
    | username    | password    | error for incorrect creds |

  Scenario Outline: Boundary case for failed login attempts
  Background: The system should handle various failed login attempts
  Scenario: Login with just one failed attempt
  Given a user has just one failed login attempt
  When the user enters the correct credentials after the attempt
  Then the system should not lock the account but may show a warning
  Examples:
  | username    | password    | no lock, possible warning |
  | userA       | userpassA    | no lock, possible warning |

  Examples:
    | wronguser   | wrongpass   | denied, error         |

  Scenario Outline: Unsuccessful login with special characters
  Given a user with special characters in the username or password attempts to log in
  When the user enters special characters in the username or password
  Then the system should sanitize the input and proceed with login
  Examples:
  | username    | password    | input sanitized, proceed |
  | user!@#    | userp@#1    | sanitized, proceed      |

  Examples:
    | wronguser   | wrongpass   | denied, error         |
